content.text: The project’s total bill of quantities (LV) stands at €144,822. However, a critical discrepancy exists: the printed net sum of €160,242 incorrectly includes €15,420 in optional/need-based positions (items 2.1.1.60, 2.1.2.30, 2.1.2.90, 2.1.3.50) that should not be part of the mandatory offer value. This requires immediate correction to ensure accurate cost estimation. Additionally, several medium-risk items lack essential technical specifications required by VOB/C §4.2.1, including missing details for paving, asphalt, masonry, concrete reinforcement, insulation, and waste disposal. These omissions pose compliance risks and potential cost uncertainties. Prioritize correcting the sum calculation and completing all missing technical descriptions to finalize a compliant and accurate estimate.
